title: S 级核心词 · 第 1 组
objectives: 认识并会读这 40 个高频词：点 🔊 音标听发音，跟读一遍
记住每个词的**中文意思**和**英文释义**，并用近义词、反义词把意思连成一片
在例句短文里认出这些词，体会它们在句子里的语气（褒、贬、中性）

items.zh: 宣告无效，废除，取消（婚姻、法律、合同等）
items.en: to declare something legally invalid or cancel it officially
items.root: an-(ad-，向) + nul(无) → 使归于无 → 废除

items.zh: 令人生畏的，难以对付的；强大的，艰巨的
items.en: difficult to deal with; inspiring awe or fear

items.zh: 前任，前辈；（被取代的）前身，原有事物
items.en: a person who held a position or role before another
items.root: pre-(之前) + de-(离开) + cess(走) + -or(人) → 先离开的人 → 前任

items.zh: 漫不经心的，若无其事的，冷静随意的
items.en: calm and casually unconcerned
items.root: non-(不) + chal(热、在乎) + -ant → 不热心的 → 漫不经心

items.zh: 忍受，容许（常用于否定句）；n. 小溪
items.en: to tolerate or allow (usually used in negative statements)

blocks.text: The incoming director vowed to [[annul]] a contract that her [[predecessor]] had signed, even though the legal obstacles looked [[formidable]]. Her colleagues stayed [[nonchalant]], but she would not [[brook]] any further delay.

gloss.formidable: 令人生畏的，难以对付的
gloss.nonchalant: 漫不经心的，若无其事的

items.zh: 挖掘，开凿；发掘（古迹、遗物）；挖空
items.en: to dig out or uncover by digging
items.root: ex-(出) + cav(洞) + -ate(动词) → 挖出洞来 → 挖掘

items.zh: 掩饰（真实感受、意图），伪装；装糊涂
items.en: to hide one's true feelings or intentions behind a false appearance
items.root: dis-(分开、不) + sembl(像) → 让人看不出真样 → 掩饰

items.zh: 小集团的，排外的，拉帮结派的
items.en: tending to form small exclusive groups
items.root: clique(小圈子) + -ish(……的) → 小圈子的 → 排外的

items.zh: 使转向，改道；转移（注意力）；使消遣，使娱乐；挪用（资金）
items.en: to turn aside from a course; to amuse
items.root: di-(dis-，分开) + vert(转) → 转向别处 → 转移

items.zh: 平庸无奇的，乏味的；n. 行人；步行的
items.en: dull and unimaginative
items.root: ped(脚) + -estrian → 靠脚走的人 → 行人；引申为步子平常、乏味

blocks.text: When teams began to [[excavate]] the old harbor, a [[cliquish]] circle of officials tried to [[divert]] the press by calling the project a [[pedestrian]] affair, while they [[dissemble]] about what had already been found.

gloss.pedestrian: 平庸无奇的，令人厌倦的

items.zh: （威胁性地）挥舞，炫耀地挥动
items.en: to wave or flourish, often in a threatening way
items.root: brand(剑，古义) + -ish(动词) → 挥剑 → 挥舞

items.zh: 巨大的，庞大的
items.en: extremely large
items.root: gigant(巨人) + -ic(……的) → 巨人般的 → 巨大的

items.zh: 派系，小集团；派系斗争，内讧
items.en: a small group within a larger one, often quarrelsome
items.root: fact(做) + -ion(名词) → 一起做事的一帮人 → 派系

items.zh: n. 拼凑物，杂烩，混合物；拼布；adj. 拼凑的，杂乱混合的
items.en: something made of many different pieces or elements
items.root: patch(补丁) + work(活) → 补丁拼成的东西 → 拼凑物

items.zh: 有敌意的，不友好的；有害的，不利的
items.en: hostile or harmful
items.root: in-(不) + amic(朋友) + -al(……的) → 不是朋友的 → 有敌意

blocks.text: A protester began to [[brandish]] a [[gigantic]] banner, and soon the crowd split into rival [[factions|faction]], their complaints a [[patchwork]] of grievances that were openly [[inimical]] to one another.

items.zh: 有骑士风度的，（尤指对女性）殷勤有礼的；侠义的
items.en: courteous and considerate, especially toward women
items.root: chival(马，同 cheval) + -rous → 骑马的人(骑士)的 → 有骑士风度

items.zh: 使隔绝，隔离，使退隐；（法律）扣押，没收；封存
items.en: to isolate or set apart from others

items.zh: 吉利的，有好兆头的；幸运的，顺利的
items.en: showing signs of future success; favorable
items.root: au(鸟) + spic(看) + -ious → 看鸟飞的方向占卜 → 吉兆

items.zh: 浅薄的，肤浅草率的；轻易得来的，不费力的；（说话）流利但缺乏真诚的
items.en: too easy; superficial
items.root: fac(做) + -ile(易于……的) → 容易做的 → 轻易的、肤浅的

items.zh: 热切的，渴望的，热衷的；贪婪的
items.en: having a keen, eager interest
items.root: av(渴望) + -id(……的) → 渴望的

blocks.text: The [[chivalrous]] captain chose to [[sequester]] the passengers in the safest cabin, yet his crew took the calm sea as an [[auspicious]] sign and offered a [[facile]] explanation for the storm warnings, like [[avid]] card players unwilling to leave a game.

gloss.chivalrous: 有骑士风度的，(尤指对女性)彬彬有礼的

items.zh: 昏昏欲睡的，没精打采的，迟钝的
items.en: sluggish and lacking energy
items.root: Lethe(希腊神话中的忘川) + arg(工作) + -ic → 像喝了忘川水、不愿做事 → 昏沉没精神

items.zh: （一个群体、时代的）精神特质，道德准则，风气
items.en: the characteristic spirit or guiding beliefs of a community
items.root: 来自希腊语 ethos(习俗、品性) → 群体的精神特质

items.zh: 含糊的，表达不清的；模糊的，轮廓不清的；（人）茫然的，不明确的
items.en: not clearly expressed or defined
items.root: vag(游荡) → 飘忽不定 → 模糊

items.zh: （社交上的）失礼，失态，失言，出洋相
items.en: an embarrassing social blunder

items.zh: 谦逊的，谦卑的；地位低下的，卑微的；简陋的；vt. 使卑微，贬低
items.en: modest and not proud; of low rank
items.root: hum(土、地面) + -ble(……的) → 贴近地面的 → 谦卑

blocks.text: A [[lethargic]] mood hung over the office until the new manager restated the company's [[ethos]]; her speech was a little [[vague]] and contained a [[gaffe]] about the founder, but her [[humble]] apology won everyone back.

gloss.lethargic: 没精打采的，行动迟缓的

items.zh: 陈腐的，平庸的，老套的，缺乏新意的
items.en: so ordinary and unoriginal as to be boring

items.zh: 忠诚，效忠，拥护；（对国家、党派、君主的）忠心
items.en: loyalty or commitment to a person, group or cause
items.root: al-(ad-，向) + lig(绑) + -iance(名词) → 绑在某人身上 → 效忠

items.zh: 世界性的，国际化的，见多识广的；包容的；n. 四海为家的人，世界主义者
items.en: worldly; at home in many parts of the world
items.root: cosmo(宇宙、世界) + polit(城邦、公民) + -an → 世界公民 → 国际化的

items.zh: 取消，撤销（命令、指令）；下达相反的命令
items.en: to revoke an earlier order
items.root: counter-(反) + mand(命令) → 下达相反的命令 → 撤销

items.zh: 正式宣布，颁布（法律等）；传播，宣传（思想）
items.en: to announce or put into effect publicly

blocks.text: The speech was so [[banal]] that nobody noticed the pledge of [[allegiance]] to a [[cosmopolitan]] vision, until the minister moved to [[countermand]] an earlier order and [[promulgate]] a new rule.

gloss.cosmopolitan: 有世界性眼光的，包容的

items.zh: 突出的，扎眼的，惹人注目的；（人）强加于人的，冒失的
items.en: noticeable in an unwelcome or intrusive way
items.root: ob-(朝着、挡在前) + trus(推) + -ive(……的) → 推到你面前 → 扎眼的

items.zh: 孤立的，狭隘的，闭关自守的；岛屿的，海岛的
items.en: narrow-minded; isolated from outside influences
items.root: insul(岛) + -ar(……的) → 岛的 → 孤立狭隘的

items.zh: 谩骂，诽谤，责骂；（因被责骂而遭受的）耻辱，名誉扫地
items.en: abusive language; public disgrace
items.root: ob-(对着、反) + loqu(说) + -y(名词) → 对着人说(坏话) → 谩骂

items.zh: 虚假，伪装，假装；借口；自负，炫耀，装腔作势
items.en: a false show or claim; pretension
items.root: pre-(前) + tens(伸) + -e → 把东西伸到前面摆出来 → 假装

items.zh: 使协调，使和谐，使适应；为（乐器）调音
items.en: to bring into harmony or adjust to something
items.root: at-(ad-，向) + tune(音调) → 调到一致 → 使协调

blocks.text: The [[obtrusive]] billboard offended the [[insular]] village, whose residents heaped [[obloquy]] on the developer; he answered with a [[pretense]] of regret and promised to [[attune]] his plans to local taste.

items.zh: 暴怒，狂怒；猛烈，狂暴（风暴等）
items.en: violent, uncontrolled anger
items.root: fur(狂怒) + -y(名词) → 暴怒

items.zh: 自行决定的，可酌情处理的，随意的
items.en: left to one's own judgment; optional
items.root: dis-(分开) + cret(筛、区分) + -ion + -ary → 能自己区分判断的 → 可酌情处理
rel: secret 秘密(se- 分开 + cret)

items.zh: 喧哗的，大声叫嚷的；强烈表达意见的
items.en: loud and insistent in expressing opinions
items.root: voc(声音) + fer(带来) + -ous(……的) → 带出声音的 → 大声喧嚷

items.zh: 轻描淡写，保守陈述，少报；低估
items.en: to describe as less important or serious than it is
items.root: under-(不足) + state(陈述) → 说得比实际少 → 轻描淡写

items.zh: 颂词，称颂，致敬；贡品，贡金；（体现价值的）证明
items.en: an expression of respect or gratitude
items.root: trib(分配、给予) + -ute → 献上、给予 → 贡品、颂词

blocks.text: Her [[fury]] over the cut to the [[discretionary]] budget was [[vociferous]]; her boss tried to [[understate]] the damage and paid [[tribute]] to her years of service.

questions.explain: pretense：虚假，伪装，假装；借口；自负，炫耀，装腔作势（a false show or claim; pretension）。近义词：façade, sham。

options: 平庸无奇的，令人厌倦的
questions.explain: pedestrian：平庸无奇的，乏味的；n. 行人；步行的（dull and unimaginative）。近义词：prosaic, mundane。

questions.q: 哪个词的意思是「前任，先辈」？
questions.explain: predecessor：前任，前辈；（被取代的）前身，原有事物（a person who held a position or role before another）。

questions.q: 哪个词和 **clique** 的意思最接近？
questions.explain: faction 与 clique 近义：a small group within a larger one, often quarrelsome。

questions.q:
选最适合填入空格的词：

> The chivalrous captain chose to sequester the passengers in the safest cabin, yet his crew took the calm sea as an auspicious sign and offered a facile explanation for the storm warnings, like ____ card players unwilling to leave a game.
questions.explain: avid：热切的，渴望的，热衷的；贪婪的（having a keen, eager interest）。
